current_project.name: ecostream-hub
current_project.title: EcoStream Hub: Sustainable Media Server Manager
current_project.description: EcoStream Hub is a web application designed for the 'Green Tech Hobbyist' who seeks to manage their digital media responsibly. It provides a user-friendly interface to organize and access various streaming sources, including publicly available IPTV channels. A core feature is its integration with guides and monitoring tools focused on setting up and managing a low-power, sustainable home media server using repurposed devices like old phones or Raspberry Pis, helping users reduce their energy consumption and extend hardware lifespan.
features: Unified media source management (IPTV, web streams)
Real-time resource monitoring for connected low-power servers
Interactive guides for sustainable server setup and optimization
Integrated media playback and content discovery

tasks.name: Project scaffold
tasks.description: Vite+React+TS with Tailwind, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, netlify.toml for deployment.

tasks.name: Core layout and routing
tasks.description: Implement a basic shell layout including a header, sidebar navigation, and setup React Router v6 for page management (Home, Sources, Guides, Monitor, Settings). Ensure responsiveness.

tasks.name: Zustand store & API client setup
tasks.description: Define a global Zustand store for application state (e.g., user preferences, media sources list). Create a placeholder API client (e.g., using `fetch` or a mock layer) for future backend interaction for media sources and server monitoring data.

tasks.name: Media source management UI
tasks.description: Develop components for adding new IPTV M3U URLs or other web-based media stream links. Display a list of configured sources, allowing basic edit/delete operations. Integrate with the Zustand store.

tasks.name: Media playback component
tasks.description: Implement a basic video player (e.g., using `react-player`) that can stream content from the added media sources. Include basic controls (play/pause, volume) and a fullscreen option. Integrate with source selection.

tasks.name: Server monitoring dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create dashboard components to display mock or placeholder data for server metrics like CPU usage, RAM utilization, and estimated power consumption. Use simple charts or progress bars for visualization.

tasks.name: Sustainable setup guides page
tasks.description: Develop a dedicated page for static content presenting step-by-step guides on setting up low-power media servers. Include sections on hardware selection (e.g., Raspberry Pi, old phones), OS installation, and recommended software.

tasks.name: Content search and filtering
tasks.description: Implement a search bar and filtering options (e.g., by source type) to help users discover content across their managed media sources.

tasks.name: User settings and persistence
tasks.description: Create a settings page allowing users to configure basic application preferences (e.g., theme, default player options). Persist these settings using local storage, managed via Zustand.

tasks.name: Refinement and testing
tasks.description: Perform UI/UX polish, ensure accessibility, add comprehensive unit tests for core components and Zustand store. Set up basic integration tests for routing and critical user flows. Prepare for deployment.
